notes: The division of 'all such as are left desolate' is named with its competing reading under rule 8: בְּנֵי takes the supplied antecedent 'such' as a present morpheme (rule 46's first rider), and the recast חֲלוֹף takes 'as are left desolate', headed on the complement under rule 44.
The 'of' between דִּין and כֹּל is the chain's own relation and belongs to the quantifier as rectum under rule 19.
